understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate the grid and complete every level by matching the carried piece's shape, color, and rotation to each goal cell, then stepping onto the matched goal.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement is performed one direction at a time; walls block movement but still consume stamina. Shape modifiers cycle the piece's shape, color modifiers cycle its color, and rotation modifiers rotate it 90° clockwise. A goal reports which attributes do not match and can only be activated when all three match simultaneously. Stamina decreases with actions, including blocked moves; when it reaches zero, a life is lost and stamina resets. Losing all lives ends the game.
